mutants.reason: Inverting the memory write enable stores a word when no write is accepted and drops accepted writes, so the data read back is wrong.

The underflow flop is no longer cleared by i_rst_n_rd. It is cleared at every clock edge while reset is high, so the underflow pulse never appears, and while reset is low it keeps following the read request.
In the 3-FF cell the pending delay counter test is inverted, so the extra delay of 1 or 2 destination cycles is released at the wrong time. The crossing latency leaves the S..S+2 window.
While the read side is blocked by a software reset, o_empty_thr would be 0 instead of 1. This breaks the empty-FIFO value required by CHK-003(a) and DEC-029.

The read FSM leaves ACK only when the synchronized write pointer is non-zero, which is the wrong flush check. The read release is delayed or never comes, or it comes at the wrong time. The o_underflow pulses and the o_sw_rst_busy fall time change, and the handshake can deadlock.
With +AFIFO_MSYNC_EN=0 the model would be enabled instead of off, because the condition (arg == 0) is true. The crossing latency is then random rather than the nominal S=2 edges.

The write FSM leaves REL when either the acknowledge is 0 or the synchronized read pointer is 0, instead of both. Busy falls before the acknowledge round trip is complete, so the write side is released too early and the read side is not released first.
The reset condition of the busy flop is inverted. o_sw_rst_busy is not cleared to 0 when i_rst_n_wr asserts, and it is forced to 0 while reset is released, so it never goes high.

The read FSM leaves ACK as soon as the synchronized write pointer is 0, without waiting for the request to fall. The read side is released early, during HOLD, and can re-enter RST. o_underflow pulses then return too early and the release order and the handshake are broken.

The acknowledge flop would reset to 1 instead of 0. After a read-domain reset the write side can see a spurious acknowledge, so the software reset handshake can skip the REQ wait, for example when a software reset is requested while the read reset is still held.

With a zero extra delay the model sets pend=1 instead of 0. On the next edge the stale sim_nxt is loaded into sim_cur, so the synchronizer output goes back to an old or X value. This gives wrong crossing values.

In the synthesis cell the reset polarity is inverted. The chain is cleared while RN is high and shifts while RN is low, so the pointer synchronizer outputs 0 and the flags and data crossing are broken.
